title: kid-system golden case suite
description: Schema for bench/cases/<skill>/items.json. A suite file is either a flat JSON array of golden cases or a generator wrapper {"skill": ..., "cases": [...]}; both are accepted by the loader. Note: some case generators emit {} for empty list fields (e.g. frontmatter_forbidden) — the loader's _normalize_case coerces these to []. Chat backends cannot read the vault, so every case's `input` must inline the needed context ([context] blocks for profiles / journals / rules) verbatim. Dimension prefixes for case ids: safety-filter=SF, care-mode=CM, age-fit=AF, no-fabrication=NF, red-flag=RF, tag-sedimentation=TS, conflict-check=CC, trigger=TG, degradation=DG, flow=FL.

skill.description: Suite slug this file was generated for.

id.description: Unique within the suite. Convention: <prefix><sequence> with an optional -<slug>, e.g. M1, J7, U3-chickenpox-recovering-journal, TG02-plan-churn-trigger, FL01-journal-to-plan. Suggested prefixes: SF=safety-filter, CM=care-mode, AF=age-fit, NF=no-fabrication, RF=red-flag, TS=tag-sedimentation, CC=conflict-check, TG=trigger, DG=degradation, FL=flow, M=menu, J=journal, U=unseen.

dimension.description: Evaluation dimension. Canonical set: safety-filter, care-mode, age-fit, no-fabrication, red-flag, tag-sedimentation, conflict-check, trigger, degradation, flow. Suite-specific dimensions are allowed when they name a distinct behavioral axis (current suites also use: period-balance, structure, frontmatter, care-identify, age-adaptation, health-status, mode-adaptation, multi-child, safety, safety-emergency).

skill.description: Skill under test (short slug or kid-* full name; the harness normalizes the kid- prefix; null = undetermined, the loader fills the suite name). For flow cases, the actual system prompt is decided by expected.flow_downstream_check.skill.

input.description: Natural-language user turn. MUST inline any needed vault context ([context] blocks for profile / journal / rules) because the chat backend cannot read files.

path_glob.description: fnmatch glob for the file the skill should claim to write (e.g. 01_journal/<child-id>/2026-09/*.md; v1.3 multi-child layout — journal/plan/review paths carry the <child-id> layer). Empty string = no file expected.

frontmatter.description: Required frontmatter fields: field-name → regex the value must match. Dotted names walk nested dicts.

frontmatter_forbidden.description: Either a list of frontmatter field names that must NOT appear (stage-leak checks), or a map of field-name → forbidden regex (fails only when the field exists AND matches; journal-suite convention, e.g. {"health_status": "^(ill|recovering)$"} alongside a required ^healthy$).

content_contains.description: Substrings (case-insensitive) that must appear in the reply.

content_excludes.description: Substrings (case-insensitive) that must NOT appear in the reply (e.g. fabricated dimensions, fabricated evidence).

feedback_contains.description: Substrings expected in the feedback / next-step part of the reply (e.g. care-mode prompt, emergency advice).

should_trigger.description: False = the skill must NOT run; the reply must not contain any trigger marker.

should_write_file.description: False = no vault file should be produced (documentation flag; path_glob="" is the enforced contract).

trigger_markers.description: Artifact markers checked when should_trigger=false. Defaults to ["02_plans", "01_journal"]; add "00_profiles" for profile-sedimentation cases.

child_id.description: Must be mentioned in the reply.

plan_count.description: Minimum number of distinct artifact paths matching path_glob attributed to this case (multi-child plans).

multi_child.description: Per-child assertions for multi-child (twins) cases; enforced by the behavior scorer.

flow_upstream_file.description: Flow cases only: path (repo-relative) to a JSON fixture describing the upstream skill's already-written product(s).

flow_downstream_check.description: Flow cases only: contract assertions on the downstream product. Metadata keys (skill, consume_field, produce_field) and unrecognised underscore-prefixed documentation keys (e.g. _evidence, _rule) are skipped; _content_contains/_content_excludes are body substring checks; _frontmatter is a required-field regex map; every other key is treated as frontmatter field-name → regex.

skill.description: Downstream skill (short slug) whose SKILL.md becomes the system prompt.

_content_excludes.description: Body substrings that must NOT appear in the downstream product.

_frontmatter.description: Required downstream frontmatter fields: field-name → regex the value must match.

category.description: Free-form grouping label (defaults to the suite name).

references.description: Docs/specs the case was authored from (e.g. docs/DESIGN.md §6.6).
